conf.description: VTC Systems, endpoint-syslog, syslog-raw: envelope-only extraction of RoomOS/Poly codec syslog (PRI/timestamp/hostname/app-name/message). No published body grammar exists for either vendor, so the message body is left intact in 'message' and the three placeholder body fields the work order flags are NOT implemented - real coverage gap, not a naming gap.

conf.comment: Envelope-only per the work order: neither Cisco RoomOS nor Poly VideoOS documents an endpoint syslog body grammar. Assumes RFC5424 framing (<PRI>VERSION TIMESTAMP HOSTNAME APPNAME PROCID MSGID MSG); BSD-format senders that put the app tag inside the body instead are not handled. The three PLACEHOLDER body fields (vtc.endpoint.event, vtc.call.remote_party, vtc.endpoint.admin_outcome) are deliberately not implemented - no real vendor token exists yet to parse.

functions.description: Set _time from the syslog header timestamp
Derive syslog severity from PRI (facility half is discarded, per the work order's transform note)
